div.div:
optimizer::optimize(working), one function, two steps.
1 Colour balance: Levels, once per image. lo = 0.68 percentile, hi = 99.32 percentile (lowest lo / highest hi of the 3 channels), gamma = 1 + lo/(255-lo) - (255-hi)/hi (0.01-9.99), one 256-entry table. Identity table: used as is.
2 Trim, on the balanced image: 16 border samples (4 per edge, at 0/25/50/75%) give the backdrop colour range (min/max per channel). Gaps closed with a 2x2 window. Box around the product, squared to its largest side, grown by max(10 px, 10% of that side); the square is slid inside the frame. Crop. Nothing left = Err: the file stays in INPUT.

text.tspan: 1 Colour balance: Levels, once per image. lo =
highest hi of the 3 channels), gamma = 1 +
table. Identity table: used as is.
2 Trim, on the balanced image: 16 border samples

colour range (min/max per channel). Gaps closed

div.div:
R1 · center_and_stretch
Square = longest subject-bbox side × (1 + R1_MARGIN 4.2%). A bled edge is pinned; the slack goes to the free sides. Background bands stretch outward in two passes (horizontal then vertical) — that is what fills the corners.
Inside a gated band (orange on stage 90), compose::classify_edge classifies per column against the BGC; clean columns resample as before, unstretchable ones go to inpaint::fill_segment (lateral copy with a BGC/white fallback). Empty mask, or pins no square can respect → R3
